title: The ankh, thrown out of its shop, angers no one
description: In the Black Market, the player throws the $50,000 ankh up through the hole in its shop's ceiling. It lies outside with its price, and the shopkeeper stays calm until the player climbs out and picks it up: then it's his, and the shopkeeper opens fire.
